notes.title: ⛄ SNOWMEN IS OUT NOW ⛄
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=VXIoyi9letU;full][/previewyoutube]

A fairy tale like short horror game where you get kicked out of your HOME for being very naughty!

You prepare for a journey to start a new life after the unfair and irresponsible treatment you witnessed!
But things don't turn out as expected, as it is usually the case in life...

This is different though... But it surely can't be bewitched, right?
Especially not at this holy and blessed time full of love where you spend time with your close ones!!

...Oh wait.

That time is already behind you and so is your PATH ahead, as you are already lost.
You are not alone though, for better or for worse.

...Probably worse.

Even the good old stories about the kind gift bringer seem to be all lies and can't be trusted either.
So who can you trust in this cold nightmarish realm?

The only thing left is to keep MOVING forward and finding a way back.
Hope just can't be all lost, right?!

notes.title: Small Update v1.5.1
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
- Small hidden dialog changes that hint at something terrible, or rather what someone might have done
- More yellow colors and... eyes?!
- Changed the menu chapter text to be more readable and hint at an ending branch
- Fixed rare level loading issue when spamming certain buttons
- Added a SECRET in the menu

notes.title: Update v1.5.0
notes.notes:
Update:
- Improved UX by changing the dot color when interactable items are looked at
- Slightly changed the tutorial, loading screen and controls description texts
- The "Chaser" has a slightly different design, making him easier to spot
- The "Chaser" now plays looped audio, making him easier to spot
- The "Chaser" doesn't immediately rush towards the player when spawned
- The "Chaser" now spawns at a different time, giving the player more time to inspect the changed environment
- The "Chaser" is now slower, lowering the difficulty to a more reasonable level
- Added more (self) dialog in the first section of the game
- Reduced the sign spawn frequency

notes.title: Small Demo Update v1.3.3
notes.notes:
Demo Patch Notes:
- Improved UX by changing the dot color when interactable items are looked at
- Slightly changed the tutorial and controls description text
- The "Chaser" has a slightly different design, making him easier to spot
- The "Chaser" now plays looped audio, making him easier to spot
- The "Chaser" doesn't immediately rush towards the player when spawned

notes.title: Small Demo Update v1.3.2
notes.notes:
Demo Patch Notes:

- Fixed double item collect issue before getting the collect quest
- Added a replay button at the end of the demo to retry the run and get further!

notes.title: Small Demo Update v1.3.1
notes.notes:
Demo Patch Notes:

- Added UI hint to continue the dialog if nothing is pressed for a long time
- Fixed annoying issue where the dialog is continued when returning from the pause menu via the left mouse button
- There is now more time to read the loading screen text ;)
- Added... a bucket filled with COAL?!

notes.title: Snowmen - Developer Plays the Demo (Pre Recorded)
notes.notes:
Snowmen is a fairy tale like [b]short horror game[/b] where you must escape a hellish snowy environment by [b]collecting[/b] unusual ingredients and [b]avoiding otherworldly dangers[/b]!

Watch me - the Dev of [b]Snowmen[/b] - play the demo and talk about the upcoming release.

And of course I am dressed up accordingly for this special SteamNextFest event!

notes.title: Snowmen is participating in Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that Snowmen is participating in Steam Next Fest, so go ahead
and check out the new demo version - or rather a small prequel story of the main game!

Stay warm and as always, DON'T BE NAUGHTY!!

notes.title: SNOWMEN DEMO IS LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone.

The summer is ending and the winter is coming...
AND I am thrilled to announce the Demo release of Snowmen you can get RIGHT NOW!

I hope you were good this year for your sake!!!

Enjoy the [b]Demo[/b] of the short xmas horror game [b]SNOWMEN[/b], which will be released fully on December 5th this year.
